title: 第19章 领地初建规划未来第20章 新规矩扩建军队
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
“我还不知道，我的男仆叫什么。”菲尔德询问管家。
“大人，他叫瓦罐，十六岁，父母都是农民。厨师叫餐盘、女仆分别是剪子和麻雀”
这个世界，只有掌握知识的人，贵族或者掌握超凡力量的人，才会有好听的名字。
比如菲尔德全名为菲尔德·罗斯，罗斯是玫瑰的意思，但作为名字，直接叫罗斯更贴切。就像小布什总统，全名为乔治·沃克·布什，你可以翻译为乔治·沃克·灌木丛，但听起来太怪了。
“大人，有什么吩咐吗？”瓦罐被点名，吓得声音都发颤了。
他担心自己被开除，昨天拖地的时候，他偷懒了十分钟。
“你为马车铺的临时床铺很软，要不是你铺的临时床铺，这一路过来我可能都要颠散架。”菲尔德语气轻松，打了个响指，“卡奥，奖励瓦罐一枚银币。”
“嘶~”
其他人立刻投去了嫉妒的眼光，一枚银币，相当于6天多的薪水。
瓦罐先是愣了一下，随后露出狂喜的神情，扑倒在菲尔德脚边，亲吻菲尔德的靴子“女神在上，感谢您的慷慨。”
“好运的小子。”剪子撅撅嘴，很不高兴，铺床有什么了不起，她还会暖床呢。
瓦罐心里默默发誓今后再也不偷懒，哪怕是一分钟。
“一个月评选一次，每个人都可能得到银币的赏赐，只要表现好的话，人人都有机会。厨师做出美味的佳肴，女仆扫干净房间，诸如此类，我都看在眼里。”
众人呼吸急促，互相对视，都从彼此的眼中，看出火热的竞争。
菲尔德嘴角微微上扬，今后他们的工作效率，将会被银币点燃。最重要的是，会出现诸如举报、打小报告的情况，菲尔德需要他们这么做，手下的人抱团未必是好事，会出现合伙欺瞒领主的现象。
“行了，你们去忙吧。”菲尔德冲众人微笑，摆手示意他们可以走了，众人立刻快步离开，但管家挪了两步，又踌躇地走回来，菲尔德疑惑道，“怎么了？”
“大人，呃，虽然这么说不好，但我作为您的管家，有必要给您提一些建议。”卡奥自从活着进入夜幕领后，一改之前的满嘴怨言，开始认真工作。
菲尔德挑挑眉“畅所欲言。”
“是关于种族的问题，您似乎给了亚人上升渠道，许诺他们成为自由民的可能，但亚人和我们不一样，他们愚蠢，额，抱歉，除了阿诗娜大人外，其余人似乎没必要给他们自由。”
菲尔德沉思片刻“我们如今在诅咒之地，周围充斥着死亡，谚语说当你处在艾泽利亚，就要当个亚泽利亚人。”

“我们夜幕领应该要有自己的规矩，明天我会宣布统一的法令，到时候你就知道了。”
晚上，菲尔德拿出纸笔，起草夜幕领的种田计划。
他用只有自己看得懂的汉字写下“劫掠和探索”。
“我的领地毛都没有，想要迅速发展，积累生产资料，光靠两百人根本做不到。”
甚至连土地，都充满了毒素。
“咚咚咚~”
房门被敲响。
“大人，是我。”门外传来阿诗娜的声音。
content_en:
"I still don't know what my valet's name is." Field asked the housekeeper.
"Sir, his name is Crock. He is sixteen years old. His parents are farmers. The chef is called Plate, and the maid is called Scissors and Sparrow respectively."
In this world, only people who possess knowledge, nobles or extraordinary power will have nice names.
For example, Field's full name is Field Rose, and Rose means rose, but as a name, it is more appropriate to call him Rose directly. Just like President George W. Bush, whose full name is George Walker Bush, you could translate it as George Walker Bush, but it sounds too weird.
"Sir, do you have any orders?" Cun Guan was so frightened that his voice trembled.
He was worried that he would be fired, so he was lazy for ten minutes yesterday when mopping the floor.
"The temporary bed you made for the carriage is very soft. If it hadn't been for the temporary bed you made, I might have fallen apart all the way." Field said in a relaxed tone, snapping his fingers, "Kaa, reward Crock with a silver coin."
"Hiss~"
Others immediately cast jealous glances. One silver coin was equivalent to more than 6 days' salary.
Crock was stunned for a moment, then showed an ecstatic expression, threw himself at Field's feet, and kissed Field's boots. "Goddess above, thank you for your generosity."
"Good luck boy." Scissors pouted, very unhappy. What's the big deal about making the bed? She can also warm the bed.
Cun Guan silently vowed never to be lazy again, even for a minute.
"The selection is held once a month. Everyone may be rewarded with silver coins. As long as they perform well, everyone will have a chance. The chef makes delicious meals, the maid cleans the room, and so on. I see it all."
Everyone was breathing rapidly and looked at each other, seeing the fierce competition in each other's eyes.
The corner of Field's mouth raised slightly. From now on, their work efficiency will be ignited by silver coins. The most important thing is that there will be situations such as reporting and snitching, and Field needs them to do this. It may not be a good thing for his subordinates to work together, and there will be a phenomenon of teaming up to deceive the lord.
"Okay, you go and do your work." Field smiled at everyone and waved his hand to indicate that they could go. Everyone left quickly, but the housekeeper took two steps and came back hesitantly. Field asked doubtfully, "What's wrong?"
"Sir, uh, although it's not good to say this, but as your steward, I need to give you some suggestions." Since Kaa entered the Night Territory alive, he changed his previous complaints and began to work seriously.
Field raised his eyebrows and "Speak freely."
"It's about race. You seem to have given demi-humans a way to rise and promised them the possibility of becoming free people. But demi-humans are different from us. They are stupid. Well, I'm sorry. Except for Lady Ashina, the rest of us don't seem to need to give them freedom."
Field pondered for a moment, "We are now in a cursed land, surrounded by death. The proverb says that when you are in Azerlia, you must be an Azerian."
"We Night Leaders should have our own rules. I will announce a unified decree tomorrow. You will know then."
In the evening, Field took out a pen and paper and drafted a farming plan for Nightfall Collar.
He wrote "Plunder and Exploration" in Chinese characters that only he could understand.
"I don't even have any territory. If I want to develop rapidly and accumulate production means, I can't do it with just two hundred people."
Even the land is full of toxins.
"Dong dong dong~"
There was a knock on the door.
"Sir, it's me." Asuna's voice came from outside the door.
